cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just putting the kettle on for your parents. They arrive in ten minutes; I'd like to greet them smiling at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sent a thumbs-up. I'm sure you meant well. I'll choose the cheerful version of our afternoon once I've heard the other part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're here already. Give that face a sentence beginning with 'I'm sorry', and I'll put out the good cups. I can manage the welcome from there.
